# Inventory

An inventory is the process of checking fixed assets.

## Starting an inventory

An administrator can start an inventory in the web admin UI.

### Permissions

Only users with the Inventory Manager role can start an inventory.

### Selecting locations

One or more locations must be selected from the hierarchy.

## Closing an inventory

An inventory can be closed when every location is synchronized.
After closing, missing assets get the "Missing" status.
